title: Re-cut the canon's agent catalog to the factors
situation: The canon on main composed agents from 22 dimensions. Six of them (heuristics, situation-awareness, learning, trigger, modalities, reasoning-strategy) change nothing an agent's definition can control; voice was split across three; 'capabilities' meant expertise and now collides with cratylus's runtime capability; model was a bare token without effort; reach was text plus model-judged guard hooks; roles carried the old workflow's procedure; there was no firmness, input or output contract, or evaluation.
decision: Keep the canon's composition (role as a bundle of defaults, persona as residue, one precedence rule, one role per agent, required invariants). Re-cut its catalog to the eighteen factors: retire the six non-levers; fold formality, audience-adaptation and transparency into voice; fold framing, satisficing and engineering principles into disposition and objective; rename capabilities to expertise; add reach as a permission ceiling, decision rights per decision class, firmness per value, model and effort through a model role, input and output contracts, memory as source of truth, and evaluation. Role cells state concepts in plain language with reasons; workflow steps move to skills.
consequences: A corpus cut, ahead of agent launch (0034), which then launches agents the corpus composes. Stance (0035) is absorbed by firmness.
